items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: I bought that trumpet from Morris... Morris Coloskey... He was a kind of big fat fella. Well, I bought a... trumpet for me, for $60.

ctx.x: What kind of a horn did you have? A hornet or a hornet?
I had a trumpet. And I forget, I bought that trumpet from Morris, how do you pronounce the name? Coloskey or? I don't know. Morris Music Shop was on Rampall Street.
That was the Morris Music Shop.

items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: he was, he was my first teacher as far as, as far as that. Because he was the one, I mean, who started me off with the trumpet

ctx.x: That was the Morris Music Shop.

Yeah, Morris Coloskey, I think it was something like that was his name. He was a kind of big fat fella. Well, I bought a, how do you call that metal again? Nickel played a trumpet for me, for $60. And that was plenty of money. Oh yeah, that was plenty of money. And I bought that trumpet. Huh? It was a Morris Special. They had written on it, Morris Special. See, well man, I thought the world of that thing. Oh yeah. Oh yeah. See? Well, like I said before, I mean, I didn't accomplish anything with Willie. But…
Did he have his teacher with his hornet or what did he teach you with? Did he have any instruments?
